verdict.rationale: Anytype documents custom Types as blueprints defining what an Object is, and stores structured metadata as Properties on Objects (e.g., bookmark title, description, favicon). Queries assemble results from user-defined criteria, which supports consistent organization and retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tag/multi-select properties, docs on user-defined property types and adding properties to notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of property-based retrieval.
